source_policy: OWNER_CHAT_TEXT_TRANSCRIBED_BY_ASSISTANT_TO_GITHUB_ISSUE; does not claim a signed GitHub owner comment

items.summary: A LAB has a stable main memory ID, typed child IDs and a chronological history. Record evidence, separate code facts/test outcomes/hypotheses/owner decisions, analyze gaps and plan tasks. Future task registry and hierarchical claim module are part of the skeleton; task execution occurs later.

On each GitHub Actions workflow completion, record workflow name, run ID, tested commit, actual controls with results and failures, and link resulting evidence to observations, gaps or chronologically prepared tasks. Recalling the continuity ID should reconstruct what was discussed and why.
Any minimal agent pool dedicated to this LAB must be linked to a canonical GACR ID and the entire relevant identity, session, role, capacity, claim, task, and evidence chain.
items.interpretation_limit: Identity type, concrete pool ID and concrete GACR reference will be determined by future owner-led steps and verification; no assignment or operational claim at this stage.

items.summary: All Door A arrivals should use the owner-GitHub-backed F1 control after existing GSCC/GSE/GACR/Q12 and before RELEASE/00_START_HERE.
items.interpretation_limit: An owner-authenticated approval must be genuine, bound to the specific arrival/session/HEAD; non-owner agents retain their own identity and actual GitHub permissions. The approval/delegation contract for non-owner actors requires design and tests before implementation.

interpretation_boundary: The owner did not issue a permanent prohibition on designing task registries/claim modules/dispatch integration. Do not perform actual task execution or automatically distribute work without later instructions.
